CoreAbilities.Description: This unit can be set up using the current Deep Strike core rules.
This unit has a Feel No Pain ability; see its datasheet for the required roll.
This unit can attach to eligible units listed on its datasheet.
When the relevant model is destroyed, resolve Deadly Demise using the current core rules and the value shown.
This unit can make its listed Scouts move before the first turn, subject to the current core rules.
Apply the current Stealth core rule when this unit is targeted.
This unit has an invulnerable save; see its datasheet for the value.
This model uses the current Support attachment rules.
Models embarked within this transport can fire using the listed Firing Deck value and the current core rules.
Apply the current Lone Operative targeting restrictions to this unit.
This unit is eligible to fight in the Fights First step.
This unit can deploy using the current Infiltrators core rule.
